title: Zones
summary: Library, hand, battlefield, graveyard, exile and the stack.

checklist.label: I know cards are always in a zone
I know the library and hand
I know the battlefield and graveyard
I know what exile and the stack are

steps.title: Where cards live
steps.body:
During a game, every card is in a [[zone]]. Think of zones as places on the table.

The main ones are your **library**, your **hand**, the **battlefield**, your **graveyard**, **exile** and **the stack**.

Knowing where a card is tells you what it can do right now.

visual.altText: A play area with each zone labelled.

steps.title: Library and hand
steps.body:
Your [[library]] is your face-down deck. Nobody may look through it or change its order.

Your [[hand]] holds the cards you've drawn. Only you can see them. You start with seven, and you usually draw one each turn.

At the end of your turn, if you have more than seven cards in hand, you discard down to seven.

visual.altText: A face-down library and a hand of seven cards.

check.question: At the end of your turn you have nine cards in hand. What happens?

options.text: I discard two, down to seven

check.hint: Seven is the most you can keep at the end of your turn.

steps.title: Battlefield and graveyard
steps.body:
The [[battlefield]] is the shared play area. Your lands, creatures and other permanents are here.

Your [[graveyard]] is your face-up discard pile. Cards go here when they're destroyed, discarded, or used up, like an instant after it happens.

Anyone can look at any graveyard at any time.

visual.altText: A destroyed creature moving to the graveyard.

check.question: A creature is destroyed. Where does it go?
check.hint: Think of the face-up discard pile.

steps.title: Exile and the stack
steps.body:
[[exile|Exile]] is for cards removed from the game. Exiled cards usually never come back.

The [[stack]] is where spells wait after you cast them, before they happen. Each player gets a chance to respond. You'll learn how in Module 9.

There's also a command zone, used mostly in the Commander format.

visual.altText: An exiled card set aside, and a spell waiting on the stack.

check.question: Which zone holds spells that are waiting to happen?
check.hint: Spells wait there so players can respond.
